question: 哪个地区的用户最多？
generated_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY region ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: 哪个类目的销售额最高？
generated_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025年每月销售额是多少？
generated_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

question: 近30天销量最高的商品 Top 5 是哪些？
generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= date('now', '-30 day') AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 5

question: 那这些商品分别属于哪个类目？
generated_sql: SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.name AS category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
